meta.title: The Town Theater
meta.textType: a paragraph about sports, music, or travel

paragraphs: The Town Theater. The town theater is a small building near the old trail. It has two hundred seats, so everybody can see the stage. Many families visit it at the weekend. A wide wooden door opens into a big hall with red seats. The town built the theater many years ago, and people still love it. Do you like stories and music? Then this is a good place for you.

Acting on the Stage. Adults and children act in the plays. A play at the theater has a length of about forty minutes. The actors wear bright costumes, and they speak in Thai. Some plays are in English, too. Each play has about eight actors. The lights go down when the play begins, and the room becomes quiet. Children under six must sit with an adult.

The Costume Exhibition. Next to the stage, there is an exhibition of old costumes. The theater collects costumes from many plays. It collects hats and shoes, too. The oldest costume is a long blue coat from a play about a king. Some masks are made of paper, and some are made of wood. The exhibition is free for everybody. Visitors may look, but they may not touch.

Music before the Play. A small band plays for ten minutes before each play. The band has a drum, a violin, and a guitar. The music is soft at the start and loud at the end. The band plays slow songs and fast songs. Children may stand near the stage and listen.

Visit Us. The theater is open from Tuesday to Sunday. The first play starts at two o'clock, and the second play starts at five o'clock. A ticket costs thirty baht for a child and sixty baht for an adult. The theater is closed on Monday. The seats near the stage are the best for children. There is a small cafe next to the entrance, and you can buy water and fruit there. The Explorers want to go there on Saturday, and they hope to see you.
